{
  "reasoning": "The defendant arranged for a falsified VAT ordinary invoice (增值税普通发票) to be issued in the name of a company, with the purpose of facilitating settlement of construction project payments. This conduct constitutes the crime of falsifying (virtually opening) VAT ordinary invoices under Article 205 of the Criminal Law. No other criminal conduct (e.g., fraud, tax evasion) is indicated beyond the illegal issuance of the invoice.",
  "final_answer": "[罪名]虚开增值税普通发票<eoa>"
}
